checked_claims.note: Within the stated balanced scope, ATT-0066's h^0 dichotomy and hyperelliptic containment together with FND-0125's splitting F≅O(2)⊕O(7) exclude B_4.

Constant fibre dimension on reduced atlases supports Grauert and the rank-3 projective-bundle model. Smooth descent gives the stack statement. For the stated DM coarse-space parenthetical, finite inertia preserves component dimensions; the tempting positive-dimensional-stabilizer counterexample is outside that scope.

The stack-level distinct-support ordering construction and its finite étale S_6-torsor are within the verified ATT-0066 scope, while ATT-0065 supplies the scheme-theoretic Fitting/Abel–Jacobi identification on Conf_6. No coarse-space torsor is asserted.

The recovery statement is defensible at the level of the pencil, hence up to PGL_2, and triviality follows on the locus having three target images and an unramified mark. The proof does not establish that this locus is dense or even nonempty on every relevant component. Fibrewise, the ordered incidence has dimension 2, while divisors whose support has at most two gamma-images are parametrically compatible with Sym^2(P^1), also of dimension 2. Thus dimension counting cannot show that the bad locus is proper; a separate argument ruling out a component filled by divisors supported on two gamma-fibres is missing.
The attempt expressly excludes the global dimension, forgetful-map, lci/Gysin, monodromy, and Hodge/Tate conclusions; confirmation of the other scoped claims would not verify the campaign target.

finding_candidates.statement: ATT-0087 supplies additional evidence that the claimed stabilizer package is incomplete: triviality is shown only conditional on a named locus, while density of that locus is not established and is not forced by dimension.

strongest_attack: CLM-0087-4 names a stabilizer-free locus and calls it dense without proving that its defining condition of at least three distinct gamma-images is generically satisfied. Both the ordered incidence fibre and the potential locus of divisors supported over two target points have dimension 2, so the supplied argument cannot exclude the latter from filling a component. The unramified-mark condition alone is generically harmless because the ramification locus is finite, but it does not repair the missing three-image argument. Consequently the theorem's exact dense-open assertion remains unresolved. The stack-versus-coarse attack was checked and does not defeat C2 on DM charts, and the theorem makes no cohomological, Borel–Moore, Tate-twist, Gysin, Kunneth, spectral-sequence, invariants/coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted-motive, algebraic-generation, or stable-pair assertion to audit.
theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero. Let B be either a locally Noetherian k-scheme or a locally Noetherian algebraic k-stack admitting a smooth atlas by locally Noetherian k-schemes. Let pi:C->B be smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, and let gamma:C->P^1_B be finite flat of degree 4 whose Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle F is fibrewise isomorphic to O(4)⊕O(5) on every geometric fibre. Let 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 be the canonical filtered CE sequence of ATT-0065 (CLM-0065-5), dual-confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109, so that deg(W_5)=16 under the SRC-0004 convention W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C. Put L=W_5⊗omega_{C/B}^{-1}. Assume the weak CE relative-canonical normalization (N) fibrewise exactly as in ATT-0066: O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_{C_b} ≅ omega_{C_b/P^1}⊗gamma_b^*A_b for some A_b in Pic(P^1_{k(b)}). Let I=Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B be the Abel–Jacobi incidence of ATT-0066 (H3), dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116, and write B_4={b:h^0(L_b)=4}, B_3={b:h^0(L_b)=3} on the underlying topological space of B. Then: (C1) No geometric point of B lies in B_4, so B_4 is empty and h^0(L_b)=3 at every geometric point. Indeed ATT-0066/CLM-0066-3 places every point of B_4 in the non-primitive hyperelliptic locus, while every such cover has relations bundle F≅O(2)⊕O(7) (FND-0125; equivalently the mechanical exclusion that a hyperelliptic genus-6 degree-four cover cannot be fibrewise O(4)⊕O(5)), contradicting the balanced hypothesis. (C2) Stack descent of the projective-bundle model: for every smooth atlas U->B by a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme, pi_*L|_U is locally free of rank 3 and base-change compatible, and I_U ≅ P((pi_*L|_U)^vee) is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle, smooth and proper of pure relative dimension 2 over U. Both the Abel–Jacobi incidence and the projectivization commute with arbitrary base change and are identified by the universal divisor, so the isomorphism descends along the smooth atlas to B; reducedness is preserved by smooth pullback in characteristic zero, and Grauert is applied only on reduced atlases (FND-0127; FND-0131). Consequently, for every irreducible component Y of a reduced atlas (or of the reduced coarse underlying space of a DM chart), dim(I|_Y)=dim(Y)+2. (C3) Finite-cover package: the distinct-support locus I^dist ⊂ I is open and not closed in I; ordering six distinct support points yields a finite étale S_6-torsor tilde I -> I^dist at stack level of pairwise-distinct sections, with neither side reduced artificially (ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6; FND-0064/FND-0075/FND-0087). On Conf_6(C/B), ATT-0065 (CLM-0065-4, CLM-0065-9), confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109, identifies tilde I scheme-theoretically with the ambient balanced CE Fitting evaluation-failure locus Z_ev. (C4) Conditional geometric recovery and dense-open stabilizer control under (N): L_b ≅ omega_{C_b}(-D_b) with D_b a fibre divisor of gamma_b, so if O(Gamma)≅L then |omega(-Gamma)| recovers gamma up to PGL_2 and Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)≅Aut(C,Gamma). On the dense open of the ordered distinct-support incidence where the six marks have at least three distinct images under gamma and at least one mark is unramified, the ordered automorphism group is trivial. No assertion is made that B is irreducible, that dim B=15, that the forgetful map to M_{6,6} is a monomorphism or quasi-finite, that the image is closed of pure codimension 4, that I^dist is nonempty on every fibre, that Z is lci, or any Hodge/Tate/monodromy conclusion.
